title: Pinebury Updates Merino Cargo Bibs for Women and Men
content:
Pinebury makes merino wool on-bike and off-bike garments here in the United States. They recently updated their merino wool bibs with some features that customers have been asking for and added a women’s-specific bib as well. Read below for all the details.

Pinebury Merino Wool Cargo Bibs

Your bib shorts do more for your ride than any other piece of kit. Version two of the first cycling bib shorts made with Nuyarn® merino wool keeps everything riders loved about the original and improves on everything we learned from a year of real-world miles.

A new 245 GSM Nuyarn® merino fabric, developed exclusively for Pinebury, brings more stretch, a heavier weight, and better durability while staying light enough to ride year round. It is comfortable from about 40°F to 80°F. A double-layer rear panel keeps the shorts completely opaque, even in direct sunlight.

The mesh is gone. The bib straps are now a soft, flat woven elastic made in Japan that lies smooth on your shoulders, and the rear pocket is cut from the same merino wool as the shell. The Elastic Interface® Titan chamois has a breathable, fast-drying Eco AirTech fabric cover that keeps up with the merino. Two side cargo pockets and 2-inch Power Grip leg bands round it out.

Charcoal is a deep black heather with a subtle texture up close. Made in the USA in small batches from RWS certified merino wool.

Version Two Updates

Version two keeps the design riders loved and improves on everything we learned from a year of real-world miles. The biggest changes are the fabric, the straps, the chamois, and a fully opaque rear panel.

Key Features

  • New Nuyarn® fabric: custom developed for Pinebury. 245 GSM with more stretch and better durability, plus the breathability and drying speed merino is known for.
  • Fully opaque: a double-layer rear panel means no sheerness, even in direct sunlight.
  • Woven Japanese straps: soft, flat elastic that lies smooth on your shoulders.
  • Titan chamois: Elastic Interface® Titan women’s pad with a breathable, fast-drying Eco AirTech fabric cover that keeps up with the merino.
  • Cargo storage: two side thigh pockets and a merino rear pocket for food, phone, or a light layer.
  • Power Grip leg bands: 2-inch elastic bands keep the legs in place without squeezing.
  • Made in USA: sewn in California in small batches.

Women’s Cargo Bibs

Bib shorts are the most important piece of cycling kit you wear. They support your body, regulate temperature, manage moisture, and protect sensitive areas, hour after hour, mile after mile.

Since we launched the first bib shorts made with Nuyarn® merino wool, one of the most common requests has been a women’s version. Here it is: the same fabric, straps, and pockets, built on a women’s-specific pattern with the women’s Elastic Interface® Titan chamois. When you invest here, you feel the difference.

Titan Pad

The chamois is the part of your bib shorts you notice most on a long ride. We chose the Elastic Interface® Titan men’s pad for its anatomic shape and support that lasts hour after hour.

  • 5-6 hour protection: high-density padding built for long days in the saddle.
  • Dual-density foam: a soft comfort layer over firmer support foam.
  • 3mm to 12mm thick: 12mm at the thickest points, 3mm at the thinnest.
  • Eco AirTech fabric cover: a recycled fabric with an open, honeycomb-like structure that is highly breathable and fast-drying, so it keeps up with Nuyarn® merino wool from the first mile to the last.
  • Pre-shaped and seamless: a three-dimensional anatomic shape with no seams, approved for short saddles.

See the updated merino wool cargo bibs from Pinebury.
